lines: Beds are up, meals are down, and the lamps in your room stay lit all night.
That is not hospitality, it is policy. Guests who wake in the dark here panic.
I have been taking water readings in this marsh for four months.
Sixty years of the level rising, and then three years of it not.
I put that in my report. Somebody sent it back and asked me to check it again.
Hydrology. Water table, flow, salinity. Honest work and I am good at it.
The others came for the Rock. I did not ask what for. You learn not to.
Two months on the stage, two months in the beds, and one month arguing about prices.
Best reed in Caelora and everybody east of here roofs with slate. No accounting for it.
Averra is a big place and I have seen a fair amount of it, and I will tell you this:
there are eleven towns in the world built over water and this is the only good one.
The others are all ports. This one is not going anywhere. It is just standing there.
